webster.text: Unjust; wicked; as an iniquitous bargain; an iniquitous proceeding.

example.quote: SHERMAN regarded the slave trade as iniquitous; but the point of representation having been settled after much difficulty & deliberation, he did not think himself bound to make opposition; especially as the present article as amended did not preclude any arrangement whatever on that point in another place of the Report.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, August 8, 1787
